biasanya\n[3:05 PM, 7/27/2026] +62 812-9988-1946: \nShare Informasi FSCM 01 Apr 2024 - Tips untuk Rekonsiliasi\nPertanyaan dari RM:\nBagaimana melakukan rekonsiliasi atas perbedaan outstanding pada KMK (ICONs) dan FSCM, hal apa saja yang perlu dilakukan?\n==============================\nDear para RM dan PS, \nBerikut beberapa tips proses rekonsiliasi yang dapat dilakukan rekan-rekan di cabang / sentra kredit:\n1. Pengecekan transaksi pada mutasi rekening KMK yang dilakukan secara manual sehingga tidak terupdate di sisi FSCM seperti pelunasan sebagian yang dalam mutasi tercantum keterangan ANGS POKOK-TUNAI. Transaksi ini hanya akan berpengaruh pada nilai outstanding dan disponible pada rekening KMK-nya namun akan membuat outstanding di FSCM menjadi lebih besar.\n2. Pengecekan transaksi pembebanan bunga namun belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi-nya. Pada skema tertentu seperti DF dan SF dimana bunga dibebankan pada rekening KMK, maka bunga yang tidak dipindahbukukan dari giro-nya akan membuat outstanding KMK lebih besar dari outstanding FSCM.\n3. Pengecekan transaksi lain di FSCM berdasarkan data pada menu dokumen dan mutasi KMK-nya. Kondisi yang pernah dialami adalah terjadinya kegagalan sistem sehingga terjadi error seperti duplikasi transaksi.\n\nBerdasarkan hasil rekonsiliasi sebelumnya pada skema SCF dengan pembebanan bunga di-setting pada ICONs, beberapa poin berikut perlu pengecekan lebih lanjut:\na. Adanya penyetoran tunai secara langsung ke KMK oleh nasabah/debitur.\nb. Bunga per bulan belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi\n\nDemikian, semoga bermanfaat.🙏🏻","resolutionSummary":"Done","complexity":"Intermediate","involvement":"Not Harap dicek Kembali.\n[09:48, 21/08/2026] TSCC W05 W06 W17 W18 & SCF: Share Informasi FSCM 01 Apr 2024 - Tips untuk Rekonsiliasi\nPertanyaan dari RM:\nBagaimana melakukan rekonsiliasi atas perbedaan outstanding pada KMK (ICONs) dan FSCM, hal apa saja yang perlu dilakukan?\n==============================\nDear para RM dan PS, \nBerikut beberapa tips proses rekonsiliasi yang dapat dilakukan rekan-rekan di cabang / sentra kredit:\n1. Pengecekan transaksi pada mutasi rekening KMK yang dilakukan secara manual sehingga tidak terupdate di sisi FSCM seperti pelunasan sebagian yang dalam mutasi tercantum keterangan ANGS POKOK-TUNAI. Transaksi ini hanya akan berpengaruh pada nilai outstanding dan disponible pada rekening KMK-nya namun akan membuat outstanding di FSCM menjadi lebih besar.\n2. Pengecekan transaksi pembebanan bunga namun belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi-nya. Pada skema tertentu seperti DF dan SF dimana bunga dibebankan pada rekening KMK, maka bunga yang tidak dipindahbukukan dari giro-nya akan membuat outstanding KMK lebih besar dari outstanding FSCM.\n3. Pengecekan transaksi lain di FSCM berdasarkan data pada menu dokumen dan mutasi KMK-nya. Kondisi yang pernah dialami adalah terjadinya kegagalan sistem sehingga terjadi error seperti duplikasi transaksi.\n\nBerdasarkan hasil rekonsiliasi sebelumnya pada skema SCF dengan pembebanan bunga di-setting pada ICONs, beberapa poin berikut perlu pengecekan lebih lanjut:\na. Adanya penyetoran tunai secara langsung ke KMK oleh nasabah/debitur.\nb. Bunga per bulan belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi\n\nDemikian, semoga bermanfaat.🙏🏻","resolutionSummary":"Info ke PS","complexity":"Intermediate","involvement":"Not Available","priority":"Not Available","supportingUnit":"Not Available","additionalInfo":"Done","primaryPic":"Anggi","collaborators":["Indah"],"rawPic":"Anggi, Indah","internalNote":"","draftReason":"","isDraft":false,"lifecycle":"Closed","sourceStatus":"Done","waitingPeriods":[],"escalationStatus":"Not Available","escalation":null,"closureDate":"2026-08-21T09:48:00","closureReason":"Actual source status: Done","closedBy":"Not Available","lastUpdate":"2026-08-21T09:48:00","reopened":false,"followUpDate":null,"actualHandlingHours":0.05,"actualHandlingRaw":"0:03:00","dataQualityFlags":[],"activity":[{"time":"2026-08-21T09:45:00","user":"Actual TSCC Source","role":"Source Import","action":"Case Imported","prev":"","next":"Closed","text":"Imported from actual TSCC source data — Batch 2.","visibility":"Internal"}],"comments":[]},{"ticket":"TSCC-ACT-2026-004427","sourceNo":"","sourceBatch":"Batch 2","sourceRow":1030,"dataEnvironment":"PRODUCTION","createdAt":"2026-08-21T16:38:00","createdBy":"Actual TSCC Source - Batch 2","requesterName":"Azizul","requesterUnit":"RM","segment":"RPB","region":"W03","rawRegion":"W03","customerName":"PT Tirta Cahaya Enim","counterpart":"PT BA","contact":"Not Available","channel":"Whatsapp","product":"SCF","subcategory":"DF","referenceNo":"Not Available","category":"Disbursement","subject":"[16:38, 21/08/2026] +62 812-6440-4657: Selamat Sore. Tips untuk Rekonsiliasi\nPertanyaan dari RM:\nBagaimana melakukan rekonsiliasi atas perbedaan outstanding pada KMK (ICONs) dan FSCM, hal apa saja yang perlu dilakukan?\n==============================\nDear para RM dan PS, \nBerikut beberapa tips proses rekonsiliasi yang dapat dilakukan rekan-rekan di cabang / sentra kredit:\n1. Pengecekan transaksi pada mutasi rekening KMK yang dilakukan secara manual sehingga tidak terupdate di sisi FSCM seperti pelunasan sebagian yang dalam mutasi tercantum keterangan ANGS POKOK-TUNAI. Transaksi ini hanya akan berpengaruh pada nilai outstanding dan disponible pada rekening KMK-nya namun akan membuat outstanding di FSCM menjadi lebih besar.\n2. Pengecekan transaksi pembebanan bunga namun belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi-nya. Pada skema tertentu seperti DF dan SF dimana bunga dibebankan pada rekening KMK, maka bunga yang tidak dipindahbukukan dari giro-nya akan membuat outstanding KMK lebih besar dari outstanding FSCM.\n3. Pengecekan transaksi lain di FSCM berdasarkan data pada menu dokumen dan mutasi KMK-nya. Pengecekan transaksi pada mutasi rekening KMK yang dilakukan secara manual sehingga tidak terupdate di sisi FSCM seperti pelunasan sebagian yang dalam mutasi tercantum keterangan ANGS POKOK-TUNAI. Transaksi ini hanya akan berpengaruh pada nilai outstanding dan disponible pada rekening KMK-nya namun akan membuat outstanding di FSCM menjadi lebih besar.\r\n2. Pengecekan transaksi pembebanan bunga namun belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi-nya. Pada skema tertentu seperti DF dan SF dimana bunga dibebankan pada rekening KMK, maka bunga yang tidak dipindahbukukan dari giro-nya akan membuat outstanding KMK lebih besar dari outstanding FSCM.\r\n3. Pengecekan transaksi lain di FSCM berdasarkan data pada menu dokumen dan mutasi KMK-nya. Kondisi yang pernah dialami adalah terjadinya kegagalan sistem sehingga terjadi error seperti duplikasi transaksi.\r\n\r\nBerdasarkan hasil rekonsiliasi sebelumnya pada skema SCF dengan pembebanan bunga di-setting pada ICONs, beberapa poin berikut perlu pengecekan lebih lanjut:\r\na. Adanya penyetoran tunai secara langsung ke KMK oleh nasabah/debitur.\r\nb. Izin konfirmasi terkait fasilitas FSCM untuk …","description":"[2:15 PM, 9/9/2026] Indra W.F PS W09: Selamat siang Pak @~Martinus Tok  dan Kak @WVC Indah . Izin konfirmasi terkait fasilitas FSCM untuk project PT Pupuk Klaimantan Timur dengan debitur CMB an PT Menara Hasil Jaya. Saat ini project masih berjalan dan belum selesai, sementara fasilitas FSCM akan jatuh tempo pada 21 September 2026 dan rencananya akan dilakukan perpanjangan.\r\n\r\nMohon arahan terkait beberapa hal berikut:\r\n1. Untuk proses perpanjangan fasilitas, apakah debitur perlu melakukan pengajuan pencairan/perpanjangan kembali dari awal, atau terdapat mekanisme khusus untuk perpanjangan fasilitas existing?\r\n2. Apakah terdapat ketentuan atau proses tertentu yang perlu dilakukan sebelum tanggal jatuh tempo agar fasilitas tidak otomatis ter-freeze/terkunci oleh sistem?\r\n3. PT Moto energy Indonesia (selisih 1.512.744)\r\n\r\nSaat ini aku tersebut freeze dikarenakan terdapat 2 invoice lewat jatuh tempo, apakah pembayarannya bisa di cicil atau harus tetap sesuai nilai per invoice\r\n\r\nTerkait dengan denda, mohon dijelaskan seperti apa mekanismenya dikarenakan pada icons saat ini belum terdapat denda atas dua invoice yang jatu tempo tersebut\r\nuntuk point pertama untuk perbedaan baki debitu berikut informasi:\r\n\r\nShare Informasi FSCM 01 Apr 2024 - Tips untuk Rekonsiliasi\r\nPertanyaan dari RM:\r\nBagaimana melakukan rekonsiliasi atas perbedaan outstanding pada KMK (ICONs) dan FSCM, hal apa saja yang perlu dilakukan?\r\n==============================\r\nDear para RM dan PS, \r\nBerikut beberapa tips proses rekonsiliasi yang dapat dilakukan rekan-rekan di cabang / sentra kredit:\r\n1. Pengecekan transaksi pada mutasi rekening KMK yang dilakukan secara manual sehingga tidak terupdate di sisi FSCM seperti pelunasan sebagian yang dalam mutasi tercantum keterangan ANGS POKOK-TUNAI. Transaksi ini hanya akan berpengaruh pada nilai outstanding dan disponible pada rekening KMK-nya namun akan membuat outstanding di FSCM menjadi lebih besar.\r\n2. Pengecekan transaksi pembebanan bunga namun belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi-nya. Pada skema tertentu seperti DF dan SF dimana bunga dibebankan pada rekening KMK, maka bunga yang tidak dipindahbukukan dari giro-nya akan membuat outstanding KMK lebih besar dari outstanding FSCM.\r\n3. Pengecekan transaksi lain di FSCM berdasarkan data pada menu dokumen dan mutasi KMK-nya. Kondisi yang pernah dialami adalah terjadinya kegagalan sistem sehingga terjadi error seperti duplikasi transaksi.\r\n\r\nBerdasarkan hasil rekonsiliasi sebelumnya pada skema SCF dengan pembebanan bunga di-setting pada ICONs, beberapa poin berikut perlu pengecekan lebih lanjut:\r\na. Adanya penyetoran tunai secara langsung ke KMK oleh nasabah/debitur.\r\nb. Bunga per bulan belum dipindahbukukan dari rekening giro afiliasi\r\n[9:48 AM, 9/22/2026] TSCC-2 (Internal Only): Demikian, semoga bermanfaat.🙏🏻\r\n[9:50 AM, 9/22/2026] TSCC-2 (Internal Only): Saat function load(){let c=storageGet(CONFIG_KEY);if(c)try{CONFIG={...structuredClone(CONFIG_DEFAULT),...JSON.parse(c)}}catch(e){}cases=seed();try{let runtime=JSON.parse(storageGet(RUNTIME_CASE_KEY)||"[]");let seen=new Set(cases.map(c=>normalizeTicket(c.ticket)));runtime.forEach(c=>{if(c&&c.ticket&&!seen.has(normalizeTicket(c.ticket))){cases.unshift(c);seen.add(normalizeTicket(c.ticket))}})}catch(e){console.warn("Runtime case storage unavailable",e)}let uniq=k=>[...new Set(cases.map(c=>c[k]).filter(v=>v&&v!=="Not Available"))].sort();CONFIG.products=uniq("product");CONFIG.categories=uniq("category");CONFIG.subcategories=uniq("subcategory");CONFIG.regions=uniq("region");CONFIG.requesterUnits=uniq("requesterUnit");CONFIG.channels=uniq("channel");ensureV14Fields();buildRequesterMaster()}function ensureV14Fields(){cases.forEach(c=>{if(!("followUpDate" in c))c.followUpDate=null;if(!c.comments)c.comments=[];if(!c.activity)c.activity=[];c.primaryPic=canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic);c.collaborators=[...new Set((c.collaborators||[]).flatMap(n=>{let raw=String(n||"").trim();if(!raw)return[];if(raw.toLowerCase()==="etika rani")return["Etika Ayu K.D","Rani"];return[canonicalPicName(raw)]}).filter(Boolean))].filter(n=>n!==c.primaryPic)})}function saveCases(){try{let runtime=cases.filter(c=>c.dataEnvironment==="RUNTIME"||c.sourceBatch==="Runtime");storageSet(RUNTIME_CASE_KEY,JSON.stringify(runtime));return true}catch(e){console.warn("Runtime case storage unavailable",e);return false}}function saveConfig(){try{storageSet(CONFIG_KEY,JSON.stringify(CONFIG))}catch(e){console.warn("Config storage unavailable",e)}}
function waitMs(c,end){return 0}function tat(c){let elapsed=Number.isFinite(c.actualHandlingHours)?c.actualHandlingHours:(c.lifecycle==="Closed"&&c.closureDate&&c.createdAt?Math.max(0,(new Date(c.closureDate)-new Date(c.createdAt))/3600000):0);return{elapsed,target:null,status:c.actualHandlingRaw&&c.actualHandlingRaw!=="Not Available"?"Actual Duration":"Not Available",ratio:0}}function aging(c){let end=c.lifecycle==="Closed"&&c.closureDate?new Date(c.closureDate):new Date();return Math.max(0,(end-new Date(c.createdAt))/3600000)}function compliance(a){return null}function avgTat(a){let v=a.map(c=>tat(c).elapsed).filter(Number.isFinite);return avg(v)}
function statusClass(s){return{"Probing":"probing","In Progress":"progress","Waiting Support":"waiting","Closed":"closed"}[s]||"closed"}function tatClass(s){return s==="Within TAT"?"tat-within":s==="Actual Duration"?"tat-near":s==="Overdue"?"tat-over":"tat-closed"}
let REQUESTER_MASTER=[];
function storageGet(key,fallback=null){try{let v=window.localStorage.getItem(key);return v===null?fallback:v}catch(e){console.warn("Storage read unavailable",key,e);return fallback}}
function storageSet(key,value){try{window.localStorage.setItem(key,value);return true}catch(e){console.warn("Storage write unavailable",key,e);return false}}
function storageRemove(key){try{window.localStorage.removeItem(key);return true}catch(e){console.warn("Storage remove unavailable",key,e);return false}}
function normalizeCategory(raw){let s=String(raw||"").toLowerCase();if(/settlement/.test(s))return"Settlement";if(/review draft|template|format|draft wording/.test(s))return"Document / Draft Review";if(/kendala fscm|kendala tiplus|system|backend|brave|error|technical/.test(s))return"System / Technical Issue";if(/akses|access|login|password|admin|channel/.test(s))return"Access / Administration";if(/disbursement|alur proses|transaksi|checking|negosiasi|diskonto|psjt|payment|process/.test(s))return"Transaction / Processing";if(/ketentuan|persyaratan|special condition|skema|policy|requirement/.test(s))return"Product / Policy Guidance";if(/inquiry/.test(s))return"Inquiry";return"Other"}
function displayCategory(c){return c.normalizedCategory||normalizeCategory(c.rawCategory||c.category)}
function cleanChatText(s){return String(s||"").replace(/^\s*\[[^\]]+\]\s*[^:]{0,80}:\s*/gm,"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim()}
function standardizeSubject(c){let raw=cleanChatText(c.rawSubject||c.subject||c.description),p=(c.product&&c.product!=="Not Available")?c.product:"Case",cat=displayCategory(c);if(/submit|submission/i.test(raw))return`Kendala Submit Transaksi ${p}`;if(/login|password|credential|akses/i.test(raw))return`Kendala Akses ${p}`;if(/review|draft|wording/i.test(raw))return`Review Draft ${p}`;if(/settlement/i.test(raw))return`Klarifikasi Settlement ${p}`;if(/status|update|cek|checking/i.test(raw)&&cat==="Inquiry")return`Inquiry Status ${p}`;if(raw&&raw.length<=85&&!/^selamat|^pagi|^siang|^halo/i.test(raw))return raw.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+raw.slice(1);return`${cat} — ${p}`}
function displaySubject(c){return c.standardizedSubject||standardizeSubject(c)}
function standardizeDescriptionText(c){let raw=cleanChatText(c.originalSource||c.description||c.subject),first=raw.split(/[.!?]\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).join('. ');return`Permasalahan:\n- ${first||'Informasi case sesuai source aktual.'}\n\nInformasi Pendukung:\n- Produk: ${c.product||'-'}\n- Channel: ${c.channel||'-'}\n- Unit: ${c.requesterUnit||'-'}\n- Wilayah: ${c.region||'-'}`}
function displayDescriptionHtml(c){return`<div><b>Permasalahan</b><ul><li>${esc(cleanChatText(c.originalSource||c.description||c.subject).split(/[.!?]\\s+/)[0]||'Informasi case sesuai source aktual.')}</li></ul><b>Informasi Pendukung</b><ul><li>Produk: ${esc(c.product||'-')}</li><li>Channel: ${esc(c.channel||'-')}</li><li>Unit: ${esc(c.requesterUnit||'-')}</li><li>Wilayah: ${esc(c.region||'-')}</li></ul></div>`}
function reminderStatus(r){let d=new Date(r.date),now=new Date(),today=new Date();today.setHours(0,0,0,0);let rd=new Date(d);rd.setHours(0,0,0,0);if(r.status==="Completed")return"Completed";if(rd.getTime()===today.getTime())return"Due Today";return d>now?"Upcoming":"Due Today"}
function urgency(c){if(c.lifecycle==="Closed")return"Normal";let now=new Date(),rem=(c.reminders||[]).filter(r=>r.status!=="Completed").sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date))[0];if(rem&&new Date(rem.date)<=addH(now,24))return"Needs Attention";if(c.followUpDate&&new Date(c.followUpDate)<=addH(now,48))return"Follow-up Soon";if(c.priority==="High")return"Needs Attention";if(c.lifecycle==="Waiting Support"&&aging(c)>48)return"Needs Attention";if(new Date(c.lastUpdate)<addH(now,-72))return"Follow-up Soon";return"Normal"}
function urgencyClass(u){return u==="Needs Attention"?"urgency-attn":u==="Follow-up Soon"?"urgency-soon":"urgency-normal"}
function originLabel(c){return [c.segment,c.requesterUnit].filter(x=>x&&x!=="Not Available").join(" / ")||"-"}
function formatBytes(n){n=Number(n)||0;if(n<1024)return n+" B";if(n<1048576)return(n/1024).toFixed(1)+" KB";return(n/1048576).toFixed(1)+" MB"}
function cleanRequesterName(v){let x=String(v??"").trim();x=x.replace(/^\s*\d{3,8}\s+/,'').replace(/^\s*[Pp]0?\d{3,8}\s+/,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();return x}
function requesterKey(v){return cleanRequesterName(v).toLowerCase().replace(/[.,;:_\-\/\\()\[\]]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
function requesterIdentityClass(v){let raw=String(v??"").trim(),k=requesterKey(raw);if(!k||["not available","n a","na","-","unknown"].includes(k))return"Missing Identity";if(/^\+?\d[\d\s-]{7,}$/.test(raw)||/\b(group|team|fscm|whatsapp|tscc)\b/i.test(raw))return"Needs Review";return"Mapped"}
function lev(a,b){a=String(a);b=String(b);let m=Array(b.length+1).fill(0).map((_,j)=>j);for(let i=1;i<=a.length;i++){let p=m[0];m[0]=i;for(let j=1;j<=b.length;j++){let t=m[j];m[j]=Math.min(m[j]+1,m[j-1]+1,p+(a[i-1]===b[j-1]?0:1));p=t}}return m[b.length]}
function similarRequester(a,b,ca,cb){let x=requesterKey(a),y=requesterKey(b);if(!x||!y)return false;if(x===y)return true;let xa=x.split(' '),ya=y.split(' ');if(xa.length<2||ya.length<2)return false;let sameContext=(ca.requesterUnit&&cb.requesterUnit&&ca.requesterUnit===cb.requesterUnit)||(ca.region&&cb.region&&ca.region===cb.region);if(!sameContext)return false;let max=Math.max(x.length,y.length),d=lev(x,y),sim=1-d/max;if(sim>=.92&&d<=2)return true;let first=xa[0]===ya[0],last=xa[xa.length-1]===ya[ya.length-1];return first&&last&&sim>=.88&&d<=3}
function buildRequesterMaster(){REQUESTER_MASTER=[];let valid=cases.filter(c=>requesterIdentityClass(c.requesterName)==="Mapped");let groups=[];for(let c of valid){let raw=cleanRequesterName(c.requesterName),g=groups.find(g=>similarRequester(g.anchor,raw,g.sample,c));if(!g){g={anchor:raw,sample:c,cases:[],variants:new Map()};groups.push(g)}g.cases.push(c);g.variants.set(raw,(g.variants.get(raw)||0)+1)}groups.sort((a,b)=>requesterKey(a.anchor).localeCompare(requesterKey(b.anchor)));groups.forEach((g,i)=>{let variants=[...g.variants.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]||b[0].length-a[0].length),name=variants[0][0],id=`REQ-${String(i+1).padStart(6,'0')}`,units=[...new Set(g.cases.map(c=>c.requesterUnit).filter(x=>x&&x!=="Not Available"))],regions=[...new Set(g.cases.map(c=>c.region).filter(x=>x&&x!=="Not Available"))];let m={requesterId:id,name,variants:variants.map(x=>x[0]),unit:units[0]||"Not Available",region:regions[0]||"Not Available",ticketCount:g.cases.length,identityStatus:variants.length>1?"Mapped • Consolidated":"Mapped",accountStatus:"Active (UAT)"};REQUESTER_MASTER.push(m);g.cases.forEach(c=>{c.requesterId=id;c.requesterCanonicalName=name;c.requesterIdentityStatus=m.identityStatus})});cases.filter(c=>requesterIdentityClass(c.requesterName)!=="Mapped").forEach(c=>{c.requesterId=null;c.requesterCanonicalName=null;c.requesterIdentityStatus=requesterIdentityClass(c.requesterName)});populateRequesterUatList()}
function populateRequesterUatList(){let dl=document.getElementById('requesterUatList');if(dl)dl.innerHTML=REQUESTER_MASTER.map(m=>`<option value="${esc(m.name)}">${esc(m.unit)} • ${esc(m.region)} • ${m.ticketCount} tickets</option>`).join('')}
function requesterMasterByName(v){let k=requesterKey(v);return REQUESTER_MASTER.find(m=>requesterKey(m.name)===k||m.variants.some(x=>requesterKey(x)===k))}
function signInRequesterUat(){let q=document.getElementById('requesterUatSearch')?.value||'',m=requesterMasterByName(q),err=document.getElementById('loginError');if(!m){err.textContent='Select a requester from the actual Requester Master.';err.classList.remove('hidden');return}err.classList.add('hidden');session={username:'req_'+m.requesterId.toLowerCase(),email:'',name:m.name,requesterName:m.name,requesterId:m.requesterId,role:'Requester',uat:true};document.getElementById('login').classList.add('hidden');applyRole();goPage('tracking')}
function renderRequesterMaster(){let body=document.getElementById('requesterMasterBody');if(!body)return;let q=requesterKey(document.getElementById('requesterMasterSearch')?.value||''),a=REQUESTER_MASTER.filter(m=>!q||requesterKey([m.name,...m.variants,m.unit,m.region].join(' ')).includes(q));body.innerHTML=a.slice(0,500).map(m=>`<tr><td>${esc(m.requesterId)}</td><td><b>${esc(m.name)}</b></td><td>${esc(m.variants.join(' • '))}</td><td>${esc(m.unit)}</td><td>${esc(m.region)}</td><td>${m.ticketCount}</td><td>${esc(m.identityStatus)}</td></tr>`).join('')||`<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty">No requester found.</div></td></tr>`}

/* LOGIN */
function findUser(v){let q=v.trim().toLowerCase();return USERS.find(u=>u.username===q||u.email===q)}function recentAccounts(){try{return rm=requesterMasterByName(userInput);if(rm)u={username:"req_"+rm.requesterId.toLowerCase(),email:"",name:rm.name,requesterName:rm.name,requesterId:rm.requesterId,role:"Requester",uat:true}}if(!u){err.textContent="Username was not value="${esc(x)}"></option>`).join("")}function initLogin(){populateLoginAccountList();let /* ROLE UI */
function applyRole(){let r=session.role,vis=(sel,on)=>document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("hidden",!on));vis(".nav-dashboard",r==="TSCC User");vis(".nav-my",r==="TSCC User");vis(".nav-quick",r==="TSCC User");vis(".nav-drafts",r==="TSCC User");vis(".nav-monitor",["Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r));vis(".nav-reports",["TSCC User","Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r));vis(".nav-performance",["Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r));vis(".nav-ai",["Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r));vis(".nav-tracking",r==="Requester");vis(".nav-config",r==="Admin");document.getElementById("newCaseBtn").classList.toggle("hidden",!["TSCC User","Team Leader"].includes(r));let lbl=document.getElementById("reportsNavLabel");if(lbl)lbl.textContent=["Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r)?"Reports & Insights":"Reports";let ini=session.name.split(" ").map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,2).join("").toUpperCase();document.getElementById("sideAvatar").textContent=ini;document.getElementById("sideUser").textContent=session.name;document.getElementById("sideRole").textContent=r;reorderRoleMenu(r);try{updateDraftCount()}catch(e){console.error(e)}try{populateFormOptions()}catch(e){console.error(e)}try{renderProfile()}catch(e){console.error(e)}try{applyLanguage()}catch(e){console.error(e)}refreshIcons()}
function reorderRoleMenu(r){let menu=document.querySelector(".menu");if(!menu)return;let order=r==="TSCC User"?["reports","dashboard","myCases","quickDraft","draftCases"]:["reports","monitoring","performance","aiInsightsPage"];if(["Team Leader","Department Head"].includes(r)){order.forEach(id=>{let el=menu.querySelector(`[data-page="${id}"]`);if(el)menu.insertBefore(el,menu.querySelector('.menu-label:last-of-type'))})}}
const META={quickDraft:["Quick Draft","Fast case capture with optional AI-assisted structuring."],aiInsightsPage:["AI Insights","Evidence-based investigation signals."],dashboard:["Dashboard","Personal case handling and workload workspace."],myCases:["My Cases","Personal case workspace."],draftCases:["Draft Cases","Continue incomplete tickets."],newCase:["New Case","Capture a case quickly and clearly."],monitoring:["Case Monitoring","Team-wide case visibility."],reports:["Regional & Case Insights","Regional analysis, inquiry patterns, and investigation signals."],performance:["Team Workload & Activity","Operational workload without individual TAT scoring."],tracking:["My Requests","See tickets, progress, and requester-visible updates."],configuration:["Configuration","Admin settings."],profile:["Profile","Personal and system-managed account information."],accountSettings:["Account Settings","Password and security."]};
function goPage(id){let p=document.getElementById(id);if(!p)return;document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));p.classList.add("active");document.querySelectorAll(".menu-item[data-page]").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x.dataset.page===id));let m=META[id]||["T-CAMS",""];if(id==="reports"&&session?.role==="TSCC User")m=["Reports","Personal case reporting."];document.getElementById("pageTitle").textContent=m[0];document.getElementById("pageSubtitle").textContent=m[1];if(id==="quickDraft")renderQuickDraft();if(id==="aiInsightsPage")renderAIInsightsPage();if(id==="dashboard")renderDashboard();if(id==="myCases")renderMyCases();if(id==="draftCases")renderDraftCases();if(id==="monitoring")renderTeamMonitoring();if(id==="reports")renderReports();if(id==="performance")renderPerformance();if(id==="tracking")renderTracking();if(id==="configuration")renderConfig();if(id==="profile")renderProfile();if(id==="accountSettings")renderAccountSettings();refreshIcons()}
function updateDraftCount(){document.getElementById("draftCount").textContent=myAccessible().filter(c=>c.isDraft&&c.lifecycle==="Probing").length}
/* CHART */
function chart(id,type,labels,data,label,onClick){let el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;if(charts[id])charts[id].destroy();charts[id]=new Chart(el,{type,data:{labels,datasets:[{label,data,borderWidth:2,tension:.3,fill:type==="line",backgroundColor:type==="line"?"rgba(45,111,174,.12)":undefined,borderColor:type==="line"?"#2d6fae":undefined}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:type==="doughnut",position:"bottom",labels:{boxWidth:9,boxHeight:9,font:{size:9}}}},scales:type==="doughnut"?{}:{y:{beginAtZero:true,ticks:{precision:0,font:{size:9}},grid:{color:"#eef2f6"}},x:{ticks:{font:{size:9}},grid:{display:false}}},onClick:(e,els)=>{if(onClick&&els.length)onClick(labels[els[0].index])}}})}
/* DASHBOARD */
function greeting(){let h=new Date().getHours();return h<12?"Good morning":h<18?"Good afternoon":"Good evening"}function attentionReason(c){let r=[];let t=tat(c).status;if(t==="Overdue"||t==="Actual Duration")r.push(t);if(c.isDraft&&aging(c)>24)r.push("Draft aging");if(c.lifecycle==="Waiting Support")r.push("Waiting support");if(aging(c)>36&&new Date()-new Date(c.lastUpdate)>12*3600000)r.push("No recent update");if(c.reopened)r.push("Reopened");return r}
function renderDashboard(){let a=myAccessible(),open=a.filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed"),need=open.filter(c=>attentionReason(c).length),wait=open.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Waiting Support"),draft=open.filter(c=>c.isDraft);document.getElementById("personalGreeting").innerHTML=`<h2>${greeting()}, ${esc(session.name.split(" ")[0])}</h2><p>Here’s your case activity from the actual TSCC source.</p>`;document.getElementById("dashboardKpis").innerHTML=`<div class="kpi" onclick="goPage('myCases')"><div class="kpi-label">Open Cases</div><div class="kpi-value">${open.length}</div><div class="kpi-hint">Current workload</div></div><div class="kpi" onclick="goPage('myCases');applyAttentionFilter()"><div class="kpi-label">Need Action</div><div class="kpi-value">${need.length}</div><div class="kpi-hint">Prioritized follow-up</div></div><div class="kpi" onclick="goPage('draftCases')"><div class="kpi-label">Draft</div><div class="kpi-value">${draft.length}</div><div class="kpi-hint">Incomplete probing</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">Waiting Support</div><div class="kpi-value">${wait.length}</div><div class="kpi-hint">Cross-unit dependency</div></div>`;let list=need.sort((x,y)=>{let sx=tat(x).status==="Overdue"?0:tat(x).status==="Actual Duration"?1:x.isDraft?2:3,sy=tat(y).status==="Overdue"?0:tat(y).status==="Actual Duration"?1:y.isDraft?2:3;return sx-sy||new Date(x.lastUpdate)-new Date(y.lastUpdate)}).slice(0,7);document.getElementById("attentionList").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(c=>`<div class="attention-item"><div class="case-id">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div><b>${esc(c.product)} • ${esc(c.lifecycle)}</b><div class="small">${esc(attentionReason(c)[0])} • Updated ${fmt(c.lastUpdate)}</div></div><button class="link" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">Review Update →</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">Nothing needs immediate attention.</div>`;let acts=[];a.forEach(c=>(c.activity||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x.user===session.name)acts.push({...x,ticket:c.ticket})}));acts.sort((x,y)=>new Date(y.time)-new Date(x.time));document.getElementById("recentActivity").innerHTML=acts.slice(0,7).map(x=>`<div class="event"><strong>${fmtActivityTime(x.time)}</strong><div class="event-text">${esc(x.action)} <button class="link" onclick="openCase('${x.ticket}')">${esc(x.ticket)}</button>${x.next?` → ${esc(x.next)}`:""}</div></div>`).join("")||`<div class="empty">No recent activity.</div>`;let months=[...Array(6)].map((_,i)=>{let d=new Date();d.setDate(1);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()-5+i);return d});chart("myTrendChart","line",months.map(d=>d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{month:"short"})),months.map(d=>a.filter(c=>{let x=new Date(c.createdAt);return x.getFullYear()===d.getFullYear()&&x.getMonth()===d.getMonth()}).length),"Cases");let pc=countBy(a,"product");chart("myProductChart","bar",Object.keys(pc),Object.values(pc),"Cases",v=>{goPage("myCases");document.getElementById("myProduct").value=v;renderMyCases()});let sc=countBy(a,"lifecycle");chart("myStatusChart","doughnut",CONFIG.lifecycle,CONFIG.lifecycle.map(x=>sc[x]||0),"Cases",v=>{goPage("myCases");document.getElementById("myStatus").value=v;renderMyCases()});document.getElementById("personalTatReference").innerHTML=renderTypicalTatReference(a);renderCalendar();renderTodayUpcoming()}
function fmtActivityTime(v){let d=new Date(v),now=new Date(),diff=now-d;if(diff<24*3600000&&d.toDateString()===now.toDateString())return d.toLocaleTimeString("en-GB",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});let y=new Date(now);y.setDate(y.getDate()-1);if(d.toDateString()===y.toDateString())return"Yesterday";return d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"2-digit",month:"short"})}
function median(vals){if(!vals.length)return 0;let s=[...vals].sort((a,b)=>a-b),m=Math.floor(s.length/2);return s.length%2?s[m]:(s[m-1]+s[m])/2}function percentile(vals,p){if(!vals.length)return 0;let s=[...vals].sort((a,b)=>a-b),i=(s.length-1)*p,lo=Math.floor(i),hi=Math.ceil(i);return s[lo]+(s[hi]-s[lo])*(i-lo)}function handlingStats(arr){let closed=arr.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Closed").map(c=>tat(c).elapsed);return{count:closed.length,median:median(closed),low:percentile(closed,.25),high:percentile(closed,.75)}}function fmtDuration(h){if(h>=24){let d=Math.floor(h/24),rh=Math.round(h%24);return`${d}d${rh?` ${rh}h`:""}`}return`${h.toFixed(1)}h`}function renderTypicalTatReference(arr,context){let base=arr;if(context){let similar=cases.filter(x=>x.lifecycle==="Closed"&&x.product===context.product&&x.category===context.category);if(similar.length>=3)base=similar}let s=handlingStats(base);return`<div class="tat-reference"><div class="tat-ref-item"><b>Median TAT</b><strong>${s.count?fmtDuration(s.median):"-"}</strong></div><div class="tat-ref-item"><b>Typical Range</b><strong>${s.count?`${fmtDuration(s.low)}–${fmtDuration(s.high)}`:"-"}</strong></div><div class="tat-ref-item"><b>Based On</b><strong>${s.count}</strong><div class="small">closed cases</div></div></div>`}
function caseWorkDate(c){let r=(c.reminders||[]).filter(x=>x.status!=="Completed").sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date))[0];return r?new Date(r.date):c.followUpDate?new Date(c.followUpDate):new Date(c.createdAt)}function renderCalendar(){let a=myAccessible().filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed"),mode=document.getElementById("calendarMode")?.value||"Month",cursor=new Date(calendarCursor),html=`<div class="calendar-shell">`;if(mode==="Week"){let day=cursor.getDay(),start=new Date(cursor);start.setDate(cursor.getDate()-day);start.setHours(0,0,0,0);document.getElementById("calendarTitle").textContent=`${start.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"2-digit",month:"short"})} – ${new Date(start.getTime()+6*86400000).toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"2-digit",month:"short",year:"numeric"})}`;html+=`<div class="calendar-grid">${["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"].map(x=>`<div class="cal-dow">${x}</div>`).join("")}`;for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let d=new Date(start);d.setDate(start.getDate()+i);html+=calendarCell(d,a,false)}html+=`</div>`}else{let first=new Date(cursor.getFullYear(),cursor.getMonth(),1),start=new Date(first);start.setDate(1-first.getDay());document.getElementById("calendarTitle").textContent=cursor.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{month:"long",year:"numeric"});html+=`<div class="calendar-grid">${["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"].map(x=>`<div class="cal-dow">${x}</div>`).join("")}`;for(let i=0;i<42;i++){let d=new Date(start);d.setDate(start.getDate()+i);html+=calendarCell(d,a,d.getMonth()!==cursor.getMonth())}html+=`</div>`}html+=`</div>`;document.getElementById("caseCalendar").innerHTML=html;if(calendarSelected)showCalendarDay(calendarSelected)}
function calendarCell(d,a,muted){let key=d.toISOString().slice(0,10),today=new Date().toDateString()===d.toDateString(),due=a.filter(c=>caseWorkDate(c).toDateString()===d.toDateString()),need=due.filter(c=>attentionReason(c).length);return`<div class="cal-day ${muted?"muted":""} ${today?"today":""}" onclick="showCalendarDay('${key}')"><div class="cal-num">${d.getDate()}</div>${due.length?`<div class="cal-stat">${due.length} case${due.length>1?"s":""}</div>`:""}${need.length?`<div class="cal-stat">${need.length} need action</div>`:""}</div>`}
function changeCalendar(step){let mode=document.getElementById("calendarMode").value;if(mode==="Week")calendarCursor.setDate(calendarCursor.getDate()+step*7);else calendarCursor.setMonth(calendarCursor.getMonth()+step);renderCalendar()}
function showCalendarDay(key){calendarSelected=key;let d=new Date(key+"T00:00:00"),a=myAccessible().filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed"&&caseWorkDate(c).toDateString()===d.toDateString());document.getElementById("calendarDayList").innerHTML=`<div class="card-head"><h3>${d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{weekday:"long",day:"2-digit",month:"long"})}</h3><div><span class="meta">${a.length} case(s)</span> <button class="link" onclick="calendarAddReminder('${key}')">+ Add Reminder</button></div></div>${a.length?a.map(c=>`<div class="work-item"><div class="case-id">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div><b>${esc(displaySubject(c))}</b><div class="small">${esc(c.lifecycle)} • ${esc(c.product)}</div></div><button class="link" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">Open</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="small">No scheduled case activity.</div>`}`}
function calendarAddReminder(key){let ticket=prompt('Ticket number for this reminder:');if(!ticket)return;let c=cases.find(x=>normalizeTicket(x.ticket)===normalizeTicket(ticket));if(!c||!canEdit(c)){alert('Ticket not found or not editable.');return}let time=prompt('Time (HH:MM, optional):','09:00')||'09:00',note=prompt('Reminder note:','Follow-up case')||'Follow-up case',d=new Date(key+'T'+time);c.reminders=c.reminders||[];c.reminders.push({id:'REM-'+Date.now(),date:iso(d),note,pic:session.name,status:'Upcoming',source:'Calendar'});c.followUpDate=iso(d);log(c,'Reminder Added',c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,note);saveCases();renderCalendar();showCalendarDay(key)}
function renderTodayUpcoming(){let now=new Date(),a=myAccessible().filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed"),todayCases=a.filter(c=>caseWorkDate(c).toDateString()===now.toDateString()||attentionReason(c).length&&new Date(c.lastUpdate).toDateString()===now.toDateString()),upcoming=a.filter(c=>caseWorkDate(c)>now).sort((x,y)=>caseWorkDate(x)-caseWorkDate(y)).slice(0,6);document.getElementById("todayCount").textContent=`${todayCases.length} case(s) need review`;document.getElementById("todayWork").innerHTML=todayCases.length?todayCases.slice(0,6).map(c=>`<div class="work-item"><div class="case-id">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div><b>${esc(c.subject)}</b><div class="small">${esc(attentionReason(c)[0]||c.lifecycle)}</div></div><button class="link" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">Open</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">No cases scheduled for today.</div>`;document.getElementById("upcomingWork").innerHTML=upcoming.length?upcoming.map(c=>`<div class="work-item"><div class="case-id">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div><b>${esc(c.subject)}</b><div class="small">${fmt(c.followUpDate)} • ${esc(c.lifecycle)}</div></div><button class="link" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">Open</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">No upcoming follow-up scheduled.</div>`}
/* MY CASES + FILTERS */
function toggleMoreFilters(){document.getElementById("moreFilters").classList.toggle("hidden")}
function myFiltered(){let a=myAccessible(),q=document.getElementById("mySearch").value.toLowerCase(),st=document.getElementById("myStatus").value,p=document.getElementById("myProduct").value,u=document.getElementById("myUrgency").value,origin=document.getElementById("myOrigin").value,last=document.getElementById("myLastUpdate").value,cat=document.getElementById("mfCategory").value,sup=document.getElementById("mfSupport").value,coll=document.getElementById("mfCollaborator").value,from=document.getElementById("mfFrom").value,to=document.getElementById("mfTo").value,now=new Date();return a.filter(c=>(!q||[c.ticket,c.requesterName,displaySubject(c),c.product,c.rawCategory,c.subcategory].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!st||c.lifecycle===st)&&(!p||c.product===p)&&(!u||urgency(c)===u)&&(!origin||originLabel(c)===origin)&&(!cat||displayCategory(c)===cat)&&(!sup||c.supportingUnit===sup)&&(!coll||(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).includes(coll))&&(!from||new Date(c.createdAt)>=new Date(from))&&(!to||new Date(c.createdAt)<=new Date(to+"T23:59:59"))&&(!last||new Date(c.lastUpdate)>=addH(now,last==="24h"?-24:last==="7d"?-168:-720)))}
function renderFilterChips(){let defs=[["myStatus","Status"],["myProduct","Product"],["myUrgency","Urgency"],["myOrigin","Origin"],["myLastUpdate","Last Update"],["mfCategory","Category"],["mfSupport","Support"],["mfCollaborator","Collaborator"],["mfFrom","From"],["mfTo","To"]],chips=defs.filter(([id])=>document.getElementById(id).value).map(([id,label])=>`<span class="chip">${label}: ${esc(document.getElementById(id).value)} <button onclick="document.getElementById('${id}').value='';renderMyCases()">×</button></span>`);document.getElementById("filterChips").innerHTML=chips.join("")+(chips.length?`<button class="link" onclick="clearMyFilters()">Clear All</button>`:"")}
function clearMyFilters(){["mySearch","myStatus","myProduct","myUrgency","myOrigin","myLastUpdate","mfCategory","mfSupport","mfCollaborator","mfFrom","mfTo"].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value="");renderMyCases()}
function applyAttentionFilter(){document.getElementById("myUrgency").value="Needs Attention";renderMyCases()}
function renderMyCases(){let all=myAccessible(),a=myFiltered(),open=all.filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed"),need=open.filter(c=>urgency(c)==="Needs Attention");document.getElementById("myQuick").innerHTML=`<span class="quick-stat"><b>${open.length}</b>Open</span><span class="quick-stat"><b>${need.length}</b>Need Action</span><span class="quick-stat"><b>${open.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==='Waiting Support').length}</b>Waiting Support</span><span class="quick-stat"><b>${all.filter(c=>c.isDraft).length}</b>Draft</span><span class="quick-stat"><b>${a.length}</b>Filtered</span>`;document.getElementById("myCasesBody").innerHTML=a.length?a.sort((x,y)=>new Date(y.lastUpdate)-new Date(x.lastUpdate)).map(c=>`<tr><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">${esc(c.ticket)}</button>${c.isDraft?' <span class="pill draft">Draft</span>':''}</td><td><b>${esc(displaySubject(c))}</b></td><td>${esc(c.product)}</td><td>${esc(originLabel(c))}</td><td><span class="pill ${statusClass(c.lifecycle)}">${esc(c.lifecycle)}</span></td><td><span class="urgency ${urgencyClass(urgency(c))}">${esc(urgency(c))}</span></td><td>${fmt(c.lastUpdate)}</td><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">View</button></td></tr>`).join(""):`<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty">No cases match the current filters.</div></td></tr>`;renderFilterChips()}
function renderQuickDraft(){populateFormOptions();document.getElementById('qdEmpty').classList.toggle('hidden',!document.getElementById('qdDraft').classList.contains('hidden'));refreshIcons()}
function inferProduct(raw){let s=raw.toLowerCase(),products=CONFIG.products.filter(x=>x!=="Not Available");return products.find(p=>s.includes(p.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' / ','/')))||(/fscm|supply chain|scf/.test(s)?'SCF':/skbdn/.test(s)?'SKBDN':/sblc/.test(s)?'SBLC':/garansi|guarantee|bguc|bank garansi/.test(s)?'DG / CG / BGUC':/lc\b|letter of credit/.test(s)?'LC':'Others')}
function generateQuickDraft(){let raw=document.getElementById('qdRaw').value.trim();if(!raw){alert('Paste a chat, email, or short note first.');return}let requester=document.getElementById('qdRequester').value.trim(),product=inferProduct(raw),cat=normalizeCategory(raw),temp={product,rawCategory:cat,category:cat,subject:raw,description:raw,rawSubject:raw,originalSource:raw,requesterUnit:'-',region:'-',channel:document.getElementById('qdChannel').value||'WhatsApp'},subject=standardizeSubject(temp);document.getElementById('qdSubject').value=subject;document.getElementById('qdProduct').value=product;document.getElementById('qdCategory').value=cat;document.getElementById('qdSubcategory').value='Other';document.getElementById('qdDescription').value=`Permasalahan:\n- ${cleanChatText(raw).slice(0,450)}\n\nInformasi Pendukung:\n- Produk: ${product}\n- Requester: ${requester||'Needs Confirmation'}`;document.getElementById('qdUrgency').value=/urgent|segera|gagal|error|kendala/i.test(raw)?'High':'Medium';document.getElementById('qdEmpty').classList.add('hidden');document.getElementById('qdDraft').classList.remove('hidden')}
function saveQuickDraft(){let raw=document.getElementById('qdRaw').value.trim(),requester=document.getElementById('qdRequester').value.trim();if(!raw||!requester){alert('Requester and source message are required.');return}let now=iso(new Date()),c={ticket:ticketId(),createdAt:now,createdBy:session.name,dataEnvironment:'RUNTIME',sourceBatch:'Quick Draft',requesterName:requester,requesterUnit:'Not Available',region:'Not Available',contact:'Not Available',channel:document.getElementById('qdChannel').value||'WhatsApp',product:document.getElementById('qdProduct').value||'Others',rawCategory:document.getElementById('qdCategory').value||'Other',normalizedCategory:normalizeCategory(document.getElementById('qdCategory').value||'Other'),category:normalizeCategory(document.getElementById('qdCategory').value||'Other'),subcategory:document.getElementById('qdSubcategory').value||'Other',subject:document.getElementById('qdSubject').value,rawSubject:raw,standardizedSubject:document.getElementById('qdSubject').value,description:document.getElementById('qdDescription').value,originalSource:raw,standardizedDescription:document.getElementById('qdDescription').value,involvement:'Business',priority:document.getElementById('qdUrgency').value,supportingUnit:'None',additionalInfo:'AI-assisted quick draft — user reviewed before save.',primaryPic:session.name,collaborators:[],internalNote:'',draftReason:'Quick Draft',isDraft:true,lifecycle:'Probing',waitingPeriods:[],escalationStatus:'Not Escalated',escalation:null,closureDate:null,closureReason:'',resolutionSummary:'',closedBy:'',lastUpdate:now,reopened:false,followUpDate:null,attachments:[],reminders:[],aiAudit:{originalSource:raw,aiGeneratedDraft:{subject:document.getElementById('qdSubject').value,product:document.getElementById('qdProduct').value,category:document.getElementById('qdCategory').value,description:document.getElementById('qdDescription').value},finalUserEditedVersion:{subject:document.getElementById('qdSubject').value,description:document.getElementById('qdDescription').value},createdBy:session.name,timestamp:now},activity:[{time:now,user:session.name,role:session.role,action:'Quick Draft Created',prev:'',next:'Probing',text:'Ticket generated from quick capture after human review.',visibility:'Internal'}],comments:[]};linkRequesterIdentity(c);cases.unshift(c);buildRequesterMaster();saveCases();updateDraftCount();alert(`Quick Draft saved: ${c.ticket}`);goPage('draftCases')}
/* DRAFT */
function renderDraftCases(){let a=myAccessible().filter(c=>c.isDraft&&c.lifecycle==="Probing").sort((x,y)=>new Date(y.lastUpdate)-new Date(x.lastUpdate));document.getElementById("draftBody").innerHTML=a.length?a.map(c=>`<tr><td><button class="link-btn" onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">${esc(c.ticket)}</button></td><td>${esc(c.requesterName)}</td><td>${esc(c.product)}</td><td>${esc(c.draftReason||"-")}</td><td>${fmt(c.createdAt)}</td><td>${fmt(c.lastUpdate)}</td><td><button class="btn primary" onclick="continueDraft('${c.ticket}')">Continue</button></td></tr>`).join(""):`<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty">No active drafts.</div></td></tr>`}
/* FORM */
function setDataList(id,vals){let el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.innerHTML=[...new Set(vals.filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b))).map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}"></option>`).join("")}
function selectedCollaborators(){return[...document.querySelectorAll('#collaboratorChips input:checked')].map(x=>x.value)}
function populateFormOptions(){let f=document.getElementById("caseForm");if(!f)return;setDataList("requesterNameList",REQUESTER_MASTER.filter(x=>String(x.identityStatus||"").startsWith("Mapped")).map(x=>x.name));setDataList("requesterUnitList",[...CONFIG.requesterUnits,...cases.map(c=>c.requesterUnit)]);setDataList("regionList",[...CONFIG.regions,...cases.map(c=>c.region)]);setDataList("channelList",[...CONFIG.channels,...cases.map(c=>c.channel)]);setDataList("productList",[...CONFIG.products,...cases.map(c=>c.product)]);setDataList("categoryList",CONFIG.categories);setDataList("subcategoryList",[...CONFIG.subcategories,...cases.map(c=>c.subcategory)]);setDataList("involvementList",CONFIG.involvement);setDataList("supportList",[...CONFIG.supportUnits,...cases.map(c=>c.supportingUnit)]);f.draftReason.innerHTML=`<option value="">Select when saving draft</option><option>Waiting requester information</option><option>Document incomplete</option><option>Need initial clarification</option><option>Need internal verification</option><option>Other</option>`;let pics=USERS.filter(u=>u.role==="TSCC User"&&u.name!==session?.name).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name));document.getElementById("collaboratorChips").innerHTML=pics.map(u=>`<label class="chip-option"><input type="checkbox" value="${esc(u.name)}"> ${esc(u.name)}</label>`).join("");if(session)f.primaryPic.value=session.name}
function editDesc(cmd){document.getElementById("descriptionEditor").focus();document.execCommand(cmd,false,null)}function insertDescTable(){document.getElementById("descriptionEditor").focus();document.execCommand('insertHTML',false,'<table border="1" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%"><tr><td>Field</td><td>Detail</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td></tr></table><p></p>')}function syncRichDescription(){let f=document.getElementById("caseForm");f.description.value=document.getElementById("descriptionEditor").innerHTML.trim()}
function previewAttachments(){let files=[...document.getElementById("caseAttachments").files];document.getElementById("attachmentPreview").innerHTML=files.map(f=>`<div class="attachment-row"><div><b>${esc(f.name)}</b><span>${esc(f.type||'file')} • ${formatBytes(f.size)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}
function startNewCase(){editingTicket=null;let f=document.getElementById("caseForm");f.reset();populateFormOptions();document.getElementById("descriptionEditor").innerHTML="";document.getElementById("attachmentPreview").innerHTML="";document.getElementById("newCaseHeading").textContent="New Case";document.getElementById("caseFormMsg").innerHTML="";goPage("newCase")}
function continueDraft(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);if(!c)return;editingTicket=ticket;let f=document.getElementById("caseForm");populateFormOptions();for(let[n,v]of Object.entries({requesterName:c.requesterName,requesterUnit:c.requesterUnit,region:c.region,contact:c.contact,channel:c.channel,product:c.product,category:displayCategory(c),subcategory:c.subcategory,subject:displaySubject(c),involvement:c.involvement,priority:c.priority,supportingUnit:c.supportingUnit,additionalInfo:c.additionalInfo,internalNote:c.internalNote,draftReason:c.draftReason})){if(f[n])f[n].value=v||""}document.getElementById("descriptionEditor").innerHTML=c.description||"";document.querySelectorAll('#collaboratorChips input').forEach(o=>o.checked=(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).includes(o.value));f.primaryPic.value=canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic);if(c.followUpDate)f.followUpDate.value=new Date(new Date(c.followUpDate).getTime()-new Date().getTimezoneOffset()*60000).toISOString().slice(0,16);document.getElementById("newCaseHeading").textContent=`Continue ${ticket}`;document.getElementById("caseFormMsg").innerHTML=`<div class="notice">Ticket number is preserved while you continue this draft.</div>`;goPage("newCase")}
function saveCaseForm(asDraft){let f=document.getElementById("caseForm");syncRichDescription();if(!f.reportValidity())return;let fd=new FormData(f),collab=selectedCollaborators();if(asDraft&&!fd.get("draftReason")){document.getElementById("caseFormMsg").innerHTML=`<div class="error-msg">Select a Draft Reason before saving.</div>`;return}let now=iso(new Date()),c=editingTicket?cases.find(x=>x.ticket===editingTicket):null,isNew=!c;if(!c)c={ticket:ticketId(),createdAt:now,createdBy:session.name,dataEnvironment:"RUNTIME",sourceBatch:"Runtime",activity:[],comments:[],waitingPeriods:[],escalationStatus:"Not Escalated",escalation:null,closureDate:null,closureReason:"",resolutionSummary:"",closedBy:"",reopened:false,attachments:[],reminders:[]};let rawCat=fd.get("category")||"Other";Object.assign(c,{requesterName:fd.get("requesterName"),requesterUnit:fd.get("requesterUnit"),region:fd.get("region"),contact:fd.get("contact"),channel:fd.get("channel"),product:fd.get("product"),rawCategory:rawCat,normalizedCategory:normalizeCategory(rawCat),category:normalizeCategory(rawCat),subcategory:fd.get("subcategory")||"Other",subject:fd.get("subject"),rawSubject:fd.get("subject"),standardizedSubject:fd.get("subject"),description:fd.get("description"),originalSource:fd.get("description"),standardizedDescription:fd.get("description"),involvement:fd.get("involvement")||"Business",priority:fd.get("priority"),supportingUnit:fd.get("supportingUnit")||"None",additionalInfo:fd.get("additionalInfo"),primaryPic:session.name,collaborators:collab,internalNote:fd.get("internalNote"),draftReason:asDraft?fd.get("draftReason"):"",isDraft:asDraft,lifecycle:asDraft?"Probing":"In Progress",lastUpdate:now,followUpDate:fd.get("followUpDate")?iso(new Date(fd.get("followUpDate"))):null});let files=[...document.getElementById("caseAttachments").files];c.attachments=[...(c.attachments||[]),...files.map(file=>({id:"ATT-"+Date.now()+"-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),name:file.name,type:file.type||"file",size:file.size,uploadedBy:session.name,uploadedAt:now}))];if(c.followUpDate){c.reminders=(c.reminders||[]).filter(r=>r.source!=="New Case");c.reminders.push({id:"REM-"+Date.now(),date:c.followUpDate,note:fd.get("reminderNote")||"Follow-up case",pic:session.name,status:"Upcoming",source:"New Case"})}linkRequesterIdentity(c);buildRequesterMaster();if(isNew){c.activity.push({time:now,user:session.name,role:session.role,action:"Case Created",prev:"",next:"Probing",text:"Ticket generated.",visibility:"Requester"});cases.unshift(c)}c.activity.push({time:now,user:session.name,role:session.role,action:asDraft?"Save Draft":"Submit Case",prev:isNew?"Probing":c.lifecycle,next:asDraft?"Probing":"In Progress",text:asDraft?(c.draftReason||"Draft saved"):"Case submitted for handling.",visibility:asDraft?"Internal":"Requester"});if(asDraft&&isNew)c.activity.push({time:now,user:session.name,role:session.role,action:"Case Received",prev:"",next:"Probing",text:"Case received / Information being reviewed",visibility:"Requester"});saveCases();editingTicket=null;updateDraftCount();document.getElementById("caseFormMsg").innerHTML=`<div class="success-msg">${asDraft?"Draft Saved":"Case Created"} • <b>${esc(c.ticket)}</b></div>`;renderDashboard();if(!asDraft)setTimeout(()=>goPage("myCases"),600)}
function lifeTrack(c){let i=CONFIG.lifecycle.indexOf(c.lifecycle);return`<div class="life-track">${CONFIG.lifecycle.map((x,n)=>`<div class="life-step ${n<i?'done':n===i?'current':''}">${esc(x)}</div>`).join("")}</div>`}function canEdit(c){return session.role==="Team Leader"||(session.role==="TSCC User"&&(c.primaryPic===sessionPic()||(c.collaborators||[]).includes(sessionPic())))}
function openCase(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);if(!c)return;let activity=(c.activity||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.time)-new Date(b.time)).map(a=>`<div class="event"><strong>${esc(a.action)}</strong><div class="event-meta">${fmt(a.time)} • ${esc(a.user)} • ${esc(a.role)}</div><div class="event-text">${esc(a.text||"")}</div></div>`).join("");document.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent=c.ticket;document.getElementById("modalSub").textContent=`${displaySubject(c)} • ${c.product}`;document.getElementById("modalBody").innerHTML=`<div class="ticket-header"><div><div class="ticket-number">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div class="small">Created ${fmt(c.createdAt)} by ${esc(c.createdBy)}</div></div><div class="badge-row">${c.isDraft?'<span class="pill draft">Draft</span>':''}<span class="pill ${statusClass(c.lifecycle)}">${esc(c.lifecycle)}</span><span class="urgency ${urgencyClass(urgency(c))}">${esc(urgency(c))}</span></div></div>${lifeTrack(c)}<div class="detail-title">Case</div><div class="detail-grid"><div class="detail-box"><b>Requester</b><span>${esc(c.requesterName)}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Product</b><span>${esc(c.product)}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Category</b><span>${esc(displayCategory(c))}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Subcategory</b><span>${esc(c.subcategory||'-')}</span></div><div class="detail-box full"><b>Standardized Subject</b><span>${esc(displaySubject(c))}</span></div><div class="detail-box full"><b>Structured Case Description</b>${displayDescriptionHtml(c)}<details class="source-details"><summary>View Original Source</summary><pre>${esc(c.originalSource||c.description||c.rawSubject||'')}</pre></details></div></div><div class="detail-title">Handling</div><div class="detail-grid"><div class="detail-box"><b>Primary PIC</b><span>${esc(canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic))}</span></div><div class="detail-box wide"><b>Collaborators</b><span>${esc((c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).join(", ")||"-")}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Supporting Unit</b><span>${esc(c.supportingUnit)}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Last Update</b><span>${fmt(c.lastUpdate)}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Next Follow-up</b><span>${fmt(caseWorkDate(c))}</span></div><div class="detail-box"><b>Urgency</b><span>${esc(urgency(c))}</span></div></div><div class="detail-title">Reminder / Follow-up</div><div id="reminderList">${renderReminderList(c)}</div><div class="detail-title">Attachments</div><div id="caseAttachmentList" class="attachment-list">${renderCaseAttachments(c)}</div><div class="detail-title">Similar Case Reference</div><div class="similar-list">${similarCaseReference(c)}</div><div class="grid2eq" style="margin-top:15px"><div><div class="detail-title">Activity Log</div><div class="timeline">${activity||'<div class="empty">No activity.</div>'}</div></div><div><div class="detail-title">Comments</div><div class="timeline">${(c.comments||[]).map(n=>`<div class="event"><strong>${esc(n.user)}</strong><div class="event-meta">${fmt(n.time)} • ${esc(n.visibility)}</div><div class="event-text">${esc(n.text)}</div></div>`).join("")||'<div class="empty">No comments.</div>'}</div></div></div>${canEdit(c)&&c.lifecycle!=="Closed"?actionPanel(c):session.role==="Team Leader"&&c.lifecycle==="Closed"?`<div class="action-panel"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="reopenCase('${c.ticket}')">Reopen Case</button></div>`:""}${["TSCC User","Team Leader"].includes(session.role)?sharePanel(c):""}`;document.getElementById("caseModal").classList.add("show");refreshIcons()}
function similarCaseReference(c){let pool=cases.filter(x=>x.ticket!==c.ticket&&x.lifecycle==="Closed"&&x.product===c.product&&displayCategory(x)===displayCategory(c)).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs((a.actualHandlingHours||0)-(c.actualHandlingHours||0))).slice(0,4);return pool.length?pool.map(x=>`<div class="similar-item"><h4>${esc(displaySubject(x))}</h4><p><b>${esc(x.product)} • ${esc(displayCategory(x))}</b></p><p><b>Issue Summary:</b> ${esc(cleanChatText(x.originalSource||x.description).slice(0,160))}${cleanChatText(x.originalSource||x.description).length>160?'…':''}</p><p><b>How It Was Handled:</b> ${esc(cleanChatText(x.resolutionSummary||'Not available').slice(0,180))}</p><p><b>Handling Reference:</b> ${x.actualHandlingHours!=null?fmtDuration(x.actualHandlingHours):'Not available'}</p><button class="link" onclick="openCase('${x.ticket}')">View Case</button></div>`).join(""):'<div class="small">No sufficiently similar closed cases found.</div>'}
function renderReminderList(c){let r=c.reminders||[];return r.length?r.map(x=>`<div class="attachment-row"><div><b>${fmt(x.date)} • ${esc(x.note||'Follow-up')}</b><span>${esc(x.pic||'-')} • ${esc(reminderStatus(x))}</span></div>${canEdit(c)?`<button class="link" onclick="completeReminder('${c.ticket}','${x.id}')">${x.status==='Completed'?'Completed':'Mark Complete'}</button>`:''}</div>`).join(""):'<div class="small">No reminder yet.</div>'}
function addReminder(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),date=prompt('Reminder date/time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM):');if(!date)return;let d=new Date(date.replace(' ','T'));if(isNaN(d)){alert('Invalid date/time.');return}let note=prompt('Reminder note:','Follow-up case')||'Follow-up case';c.reminders=c.reminders||[];c.reminders.push({id:'REM-'+Date.now(),date:iso(d),note,pic:session.name,status:'Upcoming',source:'Case Detail'});c.followUpDate=iso(d);log(c,'Reminder Added',c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,note);saveCases();openCase(ticket)}
function completeReminder(ticket,id){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),r=(c.reminders||[]).find(x=>x.id===id);if(r){r.status='Completed';log(c,'Reminder Completed',c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,r.note);saveCases();openCase(ticket)}}
function renderCaseAttachments(c){return(c.attachments||[]).length?(c.attachments||[]).map(a=>`<div class="attachment-row"><div><b>${esc(a.name)}</b><span>${esc(a.type||'file')} • ${formatBytes(a.size)} • ${esc(a.uploadedBy||'-')} • ${fmt(a.uploadedAt)}</span></div>${canEdit(c)?`<button class="link" onclick="removeAttachment('${c.ticket}','${a.id}')">Remove</button>`:''}</div>`).join(""):'<div class="small">No attachments.</div>'}
function addCaseAttachment(event,ticket){let file=event.target.files?.[0];if(!file)return;let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);if(!c||!canEdit(c))return;c.attachments=c.attachments||[];c.attachments.push({id:'ATT-'+Date.now(),name:file.name,type:file.type||'file',size:file.size,uploadedBy:session.name,uploadedAt:iso(new Date())});log(c,'Attachment Added',c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,file.name);saveCases();openCase(ticket)}
function removeAttachment(ticket,id){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);c.attachments=(c.attachments||[]).filter(a=>a.id!==id);log(c,'Attachment Removed',c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,'Attachment metadata removed.');saveCases();openCase(ticket)}
function sharePanel(c){return`<div class="share-panel"><div class="card-head"><h3>Share Ticket</h3><span class="meta">Manual action only</span></div><div class="action-buttons"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="previewShare('${c.ticket}','email')">Email</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="previewShare('${c.ticket}','whatsapp')">WhatsApp</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="previewShare('${c.ticket}','copy')">Copy Message</button></div><div id="sharePreview"></div></div>`}
function shareMessage(c,channel){if(channel==='email')return`Subject: T-CAMS Case Reference – ${c.ticket}\n\nYth. Bapak/Ibu ${c.requesterName},\n\nPermintaan Anda telah tercatat pada T-CAMS dengan nomor referensi:\n${c.ticket}\n\nTopik: ${displaySubject(c)}\n\nNomor tersebut dapat digunakan untuk memantau perkembangan case melalui T-CAMS.\n\nTerima kasih.\nTSCC`;return`Yth. Bapak/Ibu ${c.requesterName},\n\nPermintaan terkait ${displaySubject(c)} telah tercatat pada T-CAMS dengan nomor:\n${c.ticket}\n\nNomor tersebut dapat digunakan untuk memantau perkembangan case.\n\nTerima kasih.\nTSCC`}
function previewShare(ticket,channel){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),msg=shareMessage(c,channel),dest=c.contact&&c.contact!=="Not Available"?c.contact:"Destination not available in source";document.getElementById('sharePreview').innerHTML=`<div class="small" style="margin:8px 0">Destination: ${esc(dest)}</div><div class="share-preview" contenteditable="true" id="editableShare">${esc(msg)}</div><div style="margin-top:7px"><button class="btn primary" onclick="copyShareMessage()">Copy Message</button></div>`}
function copyShareMessage(){let t=document.getElementById('editableShare')?.innerText||'';navigator.clipboard?.writeText(t);alert('Message copied. Review before sending.')}
function actionPanel(c){let picOptions=USERS.filter(u=>u.role==="TSCC User").map(u=>`<option ${u.name===canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic)?'selected':''}>${esc(u.name)}</option>`).join(""),followVal=c.followUpDate?new Date(new Date(c.followUpDate).getTime()-new class="inline-select" list="supportList" value="${esc(c.supportingUnit||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>Primary PIC</label><select id="actPic" class="inline-select" ${session.role==='Team Leader'?'':'disabled'}>${picOptions}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Next Follow-up</label><input id="actFollowUp" type="datetime-local" value="${followVal}"></div><div class="field"><label>Comment Visibility</label><select id="actVisibility" class="inline-select"><option selected>Internal</option><option>Requester</option></select></div><div class="field full"><label>Comment / Update</label><textarea id="actComment"></textarea></div></div><div class="action-buttons"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="addComment('${c.ticket}')">Add Comment</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="addReminder('${c.ticket}')">+ Add Reminder</button><label class="btn secondary" style="cursor:pointer">Attach File<input type="file" class="hidden" onchange="addCaseAttachment(event,'${c.ticket}')"></label><button class="btn secondary" onclick="saveFollowUp('${c.ticket}')">Save Follow-up</button>${c.lifecycle==='Probing'?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="continueCase('${c.ticket}')">Continue</button>`:''}${c.lifecycle==='In Progress'?`<button class="btn secondary" onclick="moveWaiting('${c.ticket}')">Waiting Support</button>`:''}${c.lifecycle==='Waiting Support'?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="continueCase('${c.ticket}')">Continue Processing</button>`:''}<button class="btn danger" onclick="toggleEscalation('${c.ticket}')">${c.escalationStatus==='Escalated'?'Resolve Escalation':'Submit Escalation'}</button>${session.role==='Team Leader'?`<button class="btn secondary" onclick="reassign('${c.ticket}')">Reassign</button>`:''}<button class="btn orange" onclick="submitClose('${c.ticket}')">Submit Close</button></div></div>`}function saveFollowUp(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),v=document.getElementById("actFollowUp").value;c.followUpDate=v?iso(new Date(v)):null;log(c,"Follow-up Scheduled",c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,v?`Next follow-up: ${fmt(c.followUpDate)}`:"Follow-up schedule removed.");saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById("caseModal").classList.remove("show")}function log(c,action,prev,next,text,visibility="Internal"){c.activity.push({time:iso(new Date()),user:session.name,role:session.role,action,prev,next,text,visibility});c.lastUpdate=iso(new Date())}function addComment(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),txt=document.getElementById("actComment").value.trim();if(!txt)return alert("Enter a comment.");let vis=document.getElementById("actVisibility").value;c.comments.push({time:iso(new Date()),user:session.name,role:session.role,text:txt,visibility:vis});log(c,"Added Comment",c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,txt,vis);saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function continueCase(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),prev=c.lifecycle;if(prev==="Waiting Support"){let p=[...(c.waitingPeriods||[])].reverse().find(x=>!x.end);if(p)p.end=iso(new Date())}c.lifecycle="In Progress";c.isDraft=false;log(c,"Continue Case",prev,"In Progress","Case continued for handling.","Requester");saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function moveWaiting(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),sup=document.getElementById("actSupport").value;if(sup==="None")return alert("Select a supporting unit.");let prev=c.lifecycle;c.supportingUnit=sup;c.lifecycle="Waiting Support";c.waitingPeriods.push({start:iso(new Date()),end:null});log(c,"Waiting Support",prev,"Waiting Support",`Support requested from ${sup}.`,"Requester");saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function toggleEscalation(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);if(c.escalationStatus==="Escalated"){c.escalationStatus="Escalation Resolved";if(c.escalation)c.escalation.responseDate=iso(new Date());log(c,"Escalation Resolved",c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,"Escalation response resolved.")}else{let sup=document.getElementById("actSupport").value,reason=document.getElementById("actComment").value.trim()||"Cross-unit escalation required.";c.escalationStatus="Escalated";c.escalation={date:iso(new Date()),by:session.name,to:sup,reason,level:"Level 1",status:"Escalated"};log(c,"Submit Escalation",c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,reason)}saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function reassign(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),np=document.getElementById("actPic").value,old=c.primaryPic;c.primaryPic=np;log(c,"Primary PIC Reassigned",c.lifecycle,c.lifecycle,`${old} → ${np}`);saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function submitClose(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket),summary=prompt("Resolution / advisory summary:"),reason;if(!summary)return;reason=prompt("Closure reason:","Advisory Completed")||"Advisory Completed";let prev=c.lifecycle;c.lifecycle="Closed";c.isDraft=false;c.closureDate=iso(new Date());c.closureReason=reason;c.resolutionSummary=summary;c.closedBy=session.name;log(c,"Case Closed",prev,"Closed",summary,"Requester");saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}function reopenCase(ticket){let c=cases.find(x=>x.ticket===ticket);if(!confirm("Reopen this ticket?"))return;c.lifecycle="In Progress";c.closureDate=null;c.closureReason="";c.resolutionSummary="";c.reopened=true;log(c,"Case Reopened","Closed","In Progress","Ticket reopened by Team Leader.","Requester");saveCases();refreshAll();openCase(ticket)}

function teamFilteredCases(){let q=document.getElementById("teamSearch").value.toLowerCase(),pic=document.getElementById("teamPic").value,st=document.getElementById("teamStatus").value,inv=document.getElementById("teamInvolvement").value;return cases.filter(c=>(!q||[c.ticket,c.requesterName,canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic),(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).join(" "),c.product,displaySubject(c)].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!pic||canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic)===pic||(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).includes(pic))&&(!st||c.lifecycle===st)&&(!inv||c.involvement===inv))}

sc=countBy(a,"lifecycle");chart("monStatusChart","doughnut",CONFIG.lifecycle,CONFIG.lifecycle.map(x=>sc[x]||0),"Cases",v=>{document.getElementById('teamStatus').value=v;renderTeamMonitoring()});let onclick="openCase('${c.ticket}')">${esc(c.ticket)}</button></td><td>${esc(displaySubject(c))}</td><td>${esc(c.requesterName)}</td><td>${esc(canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic))}${(c.collaborators||[]).length?`<div function populateInsightFilters(){fill("insRegion",CONFIG.regions);fill("insProduct",CONFIG.products);fill("insCategory",CONFIG.categories);fill("insInvolvement",CONFIG.involvement);fill("insSupport",CONFIG.supportUnits)}function insightPeriodStart(mode){let now=new Date();if(mode==="month")return new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),1);if(mode==="quarter"){let q=Math.floor(now.getMonth()/3)*3;return new Date(now.getFullYear(),q,1)}if(mode==="3m"){let d=new Date(now);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()-3);return d}return null}function insightFiltered(){let a=cases,period=document.getElementById("insPeriod").value,region=document.getElementById("insRegion").value,product=document.getElementById("insProduct").value,category=document.getElementById("insCategory").value,inv=document.getElementById("insInvolvement").value,sup=document.getElementById("insSupport").value,start=insightPeriodStart(period);return a.filter(c=>(!start||new Date(c.createdAt)>=start)&&(!region||c.region===region)&&(!product||c.product===product)&&(!category||displayCategory(c)===category)&&(!inv||c.involvement===inv)&&(!sup||c.supportingUnit===sup))}function clearInsightFilters(){["insRegion","insProduct","insCategory","insInvolvement","insSupport"].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value="");document.getElementById("insPeriod").value="3m";renderManagementInsights()}function toggleInsightMore(){document.getElementById("insightMore").classList.toggle("hidden")}function regionLabel(r){return r?`Wilayah ${String(r).replace(/^W/,"")}`:"All Regions"}function topEntry(a,k){let e=Object.entries(countBy(a,k)).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]);return e[0]||null}function pct(n,d){return d?Math.round(n/d*100):0}function monthBuckets(n=6){return[...Array(n)].map((_,i)=>{let d=new Date();d.setDate(1);d.setHours(0,0,0,0);d.setMonth(d.getMonth()-n+1+i);return d})}
function multiLine(id,labels,series){let el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;if(charts[id])charts[id].destroy();charts[id]=new Chart(el,{type:"line",data:{labels,datasets:series.map(s=>({label:s.label,data:s.data,borderWidth:2,tension:.28,fill:false}))},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{position:"bottom",labels:{boxWidth:10,font:{size:9}}}},scales:{y:{beginAtZero:true,ticks:{precision:0,font:{size:9}},grid:{color:"#eef2f6"}},x:{ticks:{font:{size:9}},grid:{display:false}}}}})}
function regionalTrendDirection(r){let now=new Date(),m0=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),1),prev=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()-1,1),curr=cases.filter(c=>c.region===r&&new Date(c.createdAt)>=m0).length,pr=cases.filter(c=>c.region===r&&new Date(c.createdAt)>=prev&&new Date(c.createdAt)<m0).length;if(curr>pr*1.15)return["↑","trend-up"];if(curr<pr*.85)return["↓","trend-down"];return["→","trend-flat"]}

function renderQuestionTrend(a,months,labels){let dim=document.getElementById("questionDimension").value,key=dim,work=dim==="category"?a.map(c=>({...c,category:displayCategory(c)})):a,entries=Object.entries(countBy(work,key)).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).slice(0,5),series=entries.map(([v])=>({label:dim==="region"?regionLabel(v):v,data:months.map(d=>work.filter(c=>c[key]===v&&new Date(c.createdAt).getMonth()===d.getMonth()&&new Date(c.createdAt).getFullYear()===d.getFullYear()).length)}));multiLine("questionTrendChart",labels,series)}
function renderRegionalMatrix(a){let regs=Object.entries(countBy(a,"region")).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).slice(0,8).map(x=>x[0]),cats=Object.entries(countBy(a.map(c=>({...c,category:displayCategory(c)})),"category")).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).slice(0,6).map(x=>x[0]),max=1,vals={};regs.forEach(r=>cats.forEach(c=>{let n=a.filter(x=>x.region===r&&displayCategory(x)===c).length;vals[r+"|"+c]=n;max=Math.max(max,n)}));document.getElementById("regionalMatrix").innerHTML=`<table class="matrix-table"><thead><tr><th>Region</th>${cats.map(c=>`<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${regs.map(r=>`<tr><th>${regionLabel(r)}</th>${cats.map(c=>{let n=vals[r+"|"+c],alpha=.08+.42*n/max;return`<td><span class="matrix-cell" style="background:rgba(45,111,174,${alpha})">${n}</span></td>`}).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`}
function renderManagementFaq(a){let map={};a.forEach(c=>{let k=`${displayCategory(c)} — ${c.subcategory||'Other'}`;(map[k]??=[]).push(c)});let rows=Object.entries(map).sort((x,y)=>y[1].length-x[1].length),show=window.mgmtFaqAll?rows:rows.slice(0,10),body=document.getElementById('managementFaqBody');if(body)body.innerHTML=show.map(([k,list])=>{let p=topEntry(list,'product'),r=topEntry(list,'region');return`<tr><td>${esc(k)}</td><td>${list.length}</td><td>${p?esc(p[0]):'-'}</td><td>${r?esc(regionLabel(r[0])):'-'}</td></tr>`}).join('')}
function renderSignals(a){if(!a.length){document.getElementById("signalGrid").innerHTML='<div class="empty">No data for signals.</div>';return}let now=new Date(),recentStart=new Date(now);recentStart.setMonth(now.getMonth()-3);let priorStart=new Date(now);priorStart.setMonth(now.getMonth()-6);let candidates=CONFIG.products.map(p=>{let recent=cases.filter(c=>c.product===p&&new Date(c.createdAt)>=recentStart).length,prior=cases.filter(c=>c.product===p&&new Date(c.createdAt)>=priorStart&&new Date(c.createdAt)<recentStart).length,growth=prior?Math.round((recent-prior)/prior*100):recent?100:0;return{p,recent,prior,growth}}).sort((x,y)=>y.growth-x.growth),sig=candidates[0],regionCounts=CONFIG.regions.map(r=>({r,n:cases.filter(c=>c.region===r&&new Date(c.createdAt)>=recentStart).length})).sort((x,y)=>x.n-y.n),low=regionCounts[0],med=median(regionCounts.map(x=>x.n));document.getElementById("signalGrid").innerHTML=`<div class="signal-card"><div class="signal-type">Potential Signal</div><h4>${esc(sig.p)} inquiry activity ${sig.growth>=0?"increased":"decreased"} ${Math.abs(sig.growth)}% in the last 3 months.</h4><p>Recent volume: ${sig.recent} cases vs ${sig.prior} in the preceding 3-month period. This may reflect changing adoption, recurring friction, or another factor requiring validation.</p><div class="action"><button class="link" onclick="document.getElementById('insProduct').value='${esc(sig.p)}';renderManagementInsights()">Explore Cases →</button></div></div><div class="signal-card"><div class="signal-type">Needs Investigation</div><h4>${regionLabel(low.r)} shows relatively low TSCC inquiry activity.</h4><p>${low.n} cases in the last 3 months versus a regional median of ${med.toFixed(0)}.
