Consider comparing with sales activity and product penetration data before drawing conclusions.</p><div class="action"><button class="link" onclick="document.getElementById('insRegion').value='${low.r}';renderManagementInsights()">Explore Region →</button></div></div>`}
function renderAIInsights(a){if(!a.length){document.getElementById("aiInsights").innerHTML='<div class="empty">No data available for the current filter context.</div>';return}let topReg=topEntry(a,"region"),topProd=topEntry(a,"product"),topCat=topEntry(a.map(c=>({...c,category:displayCategory(c)})),"category"),freq=topEntry(a,"subcategory"),st=handlingStats(a),ins=[{title:"Inquiry concentration",text:`${topReg?regionLabel(topReg[0]):"The leading region"} contributes ${topReg?pct(topReg[1],a.length):0}% of cases in the selected context, with ${topProd?topProd[0]:"no dominant product"} as the leading product.`,support:`Filtered cases: ${a.length}; leading region cases: ${topReg?topReg[1]:0}; leading product cases: ${topProd?topProd[1]:0}.`,suggest:"Compare the concentration with product adoption or transaction volume before interpreting the cause."},{title:"Recurring question pattern",text:`${freq?freq[0]:"No single subcategory"} is the most frequent subcategory, while ${topCat?topCat[0]:"no category"} is the leading category.`,support:`Top subcategory: ${freq?freq[0]+" ("+freq[1]+")":"-"}; top category: ${topCat?topCat[0]+" ("+topCat[1]+")":"-"}.`,suggest:"Review whether knowledge material, guidance, or process clarification could reduce repeated questions."},{title:"Handling-time reference",text:`Closed cases have a median effective handling time of ${st.count?fmtDuration(st.median):"insufficient history"}, with a typical range of ${st.count?fmtDuration(st.low)+"–"+fmtDuration(st.high):"-"}.`,support:`Based on ${st.count} closed case(s).`,suggest:"Use this as a reference for similar-case expectations, not as an individual performance score."}];document.getElementById("aiInsights").innerHTML=ins.map(x=>`<div class="ai-insight"><h4>${esc(x.title)}</h4><p>${esc(x.text)}</p><p><b>Suggested investigation:</b> ${esc(x.suggest)}</p><details><summary>View Supporting Data</summary><div style="margin-top:5px">${esc(x.support)}</div></details><div style="margin-top:7px"><button class="link" onclick="goPage('monitoring')">View Supporting Cases →</button></div></div>`).join("")}
function renderKeyTakeaways(a){let topReg=topEntry(a,"region"),topProd=topEntry(a,"product"),freq=topEntry(a,"subcategory"),regions=new Set(a.map(c=>c.region)).size,items=[["Inquiry Concentration",topReg?`${regionLabel(topReg[0])} contributes ${pct(topReg[1],a.length)}% of filtered TSCC inquiries.`:"No regional concentration is visible."],["Product Pattern",topProd?`${topProd[0]} is the most frequently referenced product with ${topProd[1]} case(s).`:"No dominant product."],["Recurring Topic",freq?`${freq[0]} is the most recurring subcategory and may merit knowledge or process review.`:"No recurring subcategory detected."],["Regional Engagement",`${regions} region(s) are active in the current filter. Lower-volume regions should be investigated alongside external business data, not judged from inquiry volume alone.`]];document.getElementById("keyTakeaways").innerHTML=items.map((x,i)=>`<div class="takeaway"><div class="takeaway-num">${i+1}</div><div><b>${esc(x[0])}</b><span>${esc(x[1])}</span></div></div>`).join("")}
/* PERFORMANCE */
function renderCoverageMatrix(pics,dimensions,key){return`<table class="coverage-table"><thead><tr><th>PIC</th>${dimensions.map(x=>`<th>${esc(x)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${pics.map(p=>`<tr><th>${esc(p)}</th>${dimensions.map(d=>{let n=cases.filter(c=>(canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic)===p||(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).includes(p))&&(key==='category'?displayCategory(c):c[key])===d).length;return`<td title="${n} case(s)"><span class="coverage-dot ${n?'on':''}"></span>${n?`<div>${n}</div>`:''}</td>`}).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`}
function renderPerformance(){let pics=USERS.filter(u=>u.role==="TSCC User").map(u=>u.name),data=pics.map(p=>{let a=cases.filter(c=>canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic)===p||(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).includes(p)),open=a.filter(c=>c.lifecycle!=="Closed");return{p,a,open,closed:a.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Closed"),waiting:open.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Waiting Support"),products:new Set(a.map(c=>c.product)).size,categories:new Set(a.map(displayCategory)).size}});chart("teamPicCases","bar",pics.map(x=>x.split(" ")[0]),data.map(x=>x.a.length),"Cases");multiSeriesBar("teamOpenClosed",pics.map(x=>x.split(" ")[0]),[{label:"Open",data:data.map(x=>x.open.length)},{label:"Closed",data:data.map(x=>x.closed.length)}]);chart("teamProductCoverage","bar",pics.map(x=>x.split(" ")[0]),data.map(x=>x.products),"Products Covered");chart("teamWaiting","bar",pics.map(x=>x.split(" ")[0]),data.map(x=>x.waiting.length),"Waiting Support");let topProducts=Object.entries(countBy(cases,"product")).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,7).map(x=>x[0]),topCats=Object.entries(countBy(cases.map(c=>({...c,category:displayCategory(c)})),"category")).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(x=>x[0]);document.getElementById("picProductMatrix").innerHTML=renderCoverageMatrix(pics,topProducts,"product");document.getElementById("picCategoryMatrix").innerHTML=renderCoverageMatrix(pics,topCats,"category");document.getElementById("perfBody").innerHTML=data.map(x=>`<div class="perf-row"><b>${esc(x.p)}</b><span>${x.a.length}</span><span>${x.closed.length}</span><span>${x.open.length}</span><span>${x.waiting.length}</span><span>${avg(x.open.map(aging)).toFixed(1)}h</span><span>${x.products}</span></div>`).join("")}
function multiSeriesBar(id,labels,series){let el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;if(charts[id])charts[id].destroy();charts[id]=new Chart(el,{type:'bar',data:{labels,datasets:series},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{position:'bottom',labels:{boxWidth:9,font:{size:9}}}},scales:{y:{beginAtZero:true,ticks:{precision:0,font:{size:9}}},x:{ticks:{font:{size:9}}}}}})}
function renderAIInsightsPage(){let a=cases.filter(c=>(!document.getElementById('aiRegion').value||c.region===document.getElementById('aiRegion').value)&&(!document.getElementById('aiProduct').value||c.product===document.getElementById('aiProduct').value)&&(!document.getElementById('aiCategory').value||displayCategory(c)===document.getElementById('aiCategory').value));let tempSignal=document.getElementById('signalGrid'),tempAI=document.getElementById('aiInsights');if(!tempSignal){let ghost=document.createElement('div');ghost.id='signalGrid';ghost.className='hidden';document.body.appendChild(ghost)}if(!tempAI){let ghost=document.createElement('div');ghost.id='aiInsights';ghost.className='hidden';document.body.appendChild(ghost)}renderSignals(a);renderAIInsights(a);document.getElementById('aiPageSignals').innerHTML=document.getElementById('signalGrid').innerHTML;document.getElementById('aiPageInsights').innerHTML=document.getElementById('aiInsights').innerHTML}
function populateAIPageFilters(){fill('aiRegion',CONFIG.regions);fill('aiProduct',CONFIG.products);fill('aiCategory',CONFIG.categories)}
function toggleAllFaq(){window.faqShowAll=!window.faqShowAll;renderReports()}
function exportSummary(kind){let a=insightFiltered(),key=kind==='regional'?'region':kind==='product'?'product':'normalizedCategory',rows={};a.forEach(c=>{let k=key==='normalizedCategory'?displayCategory(c):c[key]||'Not Available';rows[k]=(rows[k]||0)+1});let csv='Dimension,Case Count\n'+Object.entries(rows).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).map(x=>`"${String(x[0]).replaceAll('"','""')}",${x[1]}`).join('\n'),el=document.createElement('a');el.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));el.download=`tcams_${kind}_summary.csv`;el.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(el.href)}
function exportCurrentReport(){let t=document.getElementById('exportReportType').value;if(t==='cases')exportCSV(insightFiltered(),'Current Filtered Cases');else exportSummary(t)}
/* REQUESTER */
function renderTracking(){let own=cases.filter(c=>requesterAccountMatches(c,session)).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.lastUpdate)-new Date(a.lastUpdate)),open=own.filter(c=>["Probing","In Progress"].includes(c.lifecycle)).length,waiting=own.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Waiting Support").length,closed=own.filter(c=>c.lifecycle==="Closed").length;let rs=document.getElementById("requesterSummary");if(rs)rs.innerHTML=`<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">Total Requests</div><div class="kpi-value">${own.length}</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">In Progress</div><div class="kpi-value">${open}</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">Waiting Update</div><div class="kpi-value">${waiting}</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">Completed</div><div class="kpi-value">${closed}</div></div>`;document.getElementById("requesterList").innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="card-head"><div><h3>My Tickets</h3><span class="meta">${own.length} ticket(s) • ${esc(session.requesterId||"Unmapped")}</span></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input id="requesterTicketSearch" placeholder="Search ticket / product..." oninput="filterRequesterTickets()" style="max-width:220px"><select id="requesterTicketStatus" onchange="filterRequesterTickets()"><option value="">Status</option><option>Information Review</option><option>In Progress</option><option>Coordinating with Related Unit</option><option>Completed</option></select><select id="requesterTicketProduct" onchange="filterRequesterTickets()"><option value="">Product</option>${[...new Set(own.map(c=>c.product))].sort().map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join("")}</select></div></div><div id="requesterTicketItems">${requesterTicketRows(own)}</div></div>`;document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=""}function requesterTicketRows(a){return a.length?a.map(c=>`<div class="attention-item requester-ticket-row" data-search="${esc((c.ticket+' '+c.product+' '+c.subject).toLowerCase())}"><div class="case-id">${esc(c.ticket)}</div><div><b>${esc(c.product)} • ${esc(displaySubject(c)||"Request")}</b><div class="small">${esc(requesterStatusLabel(c))} • ${fmt(c.lastUpdate)}</div></div><button class="link" onclick="document.getElementById('trackInput').value='${c.ticket}';trackTicket()">Track</button></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty"><b>No tickets linked to this requester account.</b></div>`}
function filterRequesterTickets(){let q=(document.getElementById('requesterTicketSearch')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),st=document.getElementById('requesterTicketStatus')?.value||'',pr=document.getElementById('requesterTicketProduct')?.value||'';let own=cases.filter(c=>requesterAccountMatches(c,session)).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.lastUpdate)-new Date(a.lastUpdate)).filter(c=>(!q||[c.ticket,c.product,displaySubject(c)].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!st||requesterStatusLabel(c)===st)&&(!pr||c.product===pr));document.getElementById('requesterTicketItems').innerHTML=requesterTicketRows(own)}
function trackTicket(){let input=document.getElementById("trackInput"),q=normalizeTicket(input.value);if(!q){document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=`<div class="error-msg track-error">Enter a Ticket Number.</div>`;return}let c=cases.find(x=>normalizeTicket(x.ticket)===q);if(!c){document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=`<div class="error-msg track-error">Ticket not found.</div>`;return}if(c.requesterId&&session.requesterId&&c.requesterId===session.requesterId){document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=requesterTicketDetail(c);return}if(c.requesterId&&session.requesterId&&c.requesterId!==session.requesterId){document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=`<div class="error-msg track-error">This ticket is registered to another requester account.</div>`;return}document.getElementById("trackResult").innerHTML=`<div class="notice track-error"><b>Ticket found. Additional requester verification is required.</b><div class="small" style="margin-top:4px">This historical ticket does not yet have a reliable requester identity mapping.</div></div>`}
function verifyTrackedTicket(ticket){trackTicket()}
function renderConfig(){document.getElementById("pauseWaiting").value=String(CONFIG.pauseWaitingSupport);renderRequesterMaster();document.getElementById("tatConfig").innerHTML=CONFIG.involvement.map(x=>`<div class="config-row"><span>${esc(x)}</span><input data-tat="${esc(x)}" type="number" min="1" value="${CONFIG.tatHours[x]}"><span>hours</span></div>`).join("");document.getElementById("masterSummary").innerHTML=`<div class="info-grid"><div class="info"><b>Products</b><span>${CONFIG.products.length}</span></div><div class="info"><b>Normalized Categories</b><span>${CONFIG.categories.length}</span></div><div class="info"><b>Data Environment</b><span>PRODUCTION</span></div><div class="info"><b>Subcategories</b><span>${CONFIG.subcategories.length}</span></div><div class="info"><b>Supporting Units</b><span>${CONFIG.supportUnits.length}</span></div><div class="info"><b>Lifecycle</b><span>${CONFIG.lifecycle.length}</span></div><div class="info"><b>Channels</b><span>${CONFIG.channels.length}</span></div></div>`}function saveTatConfig(){document.querySelectorAll("[data-tat]").forEach(el=>CONFIG.tatHours[el.dataset.tat]=Math.max(1,Number(el.value)||1));CONFIG.pauseWaitingSupport=document.getElementById("pauseWaiting").value==="true";saveConfig();alert("TAT configuration saved.")}function resetPrototype(){if(!confirm("Reset local cases and configuration?"))return;CONFIG=structuredClone(CONFIG_DEFAULT);cases=seed();saveConfig();saveCases();refreshAll();goPage("configuration")}
/* PROFILE */
function profileStore(){try{return JSON.parse(storageGet(PROFILE_KEY)||"{}")}catch(e){return{}}}function saveProfileStore(v){storageSet(PROFILE_KEY,JSON.stringify(v))}function profileDefaults(){let coverage={"Tio A.P. Siadari":"W03, W07, W15","Etika Ayu K.D":"W04, W08, W14, W16","Arum Anggita":"W05, W06, W17, W18","Nur Hikmah K.":"W02, W09, W12","Hania Zulfa A.N.":"W01, W10, W11","Indah Ratna P.":"W05, W06, W17, W18","Martinus":"Team-wide","Adisty Lirasha":"Management Scope"};return{fullName:session.name,email:session.email||"",phone:"",npp:`NPP-${session.username.toUpperCase()}-2026`,unit:session.role==="Requester"?"Internal BNI":"WCI / TSCC",region:coverage[session.name]||"-"}}function renderProfile(){if(!session)return;let store=profileStore(),d={...profileDefaults(),...(store[session.username]||{})},ini=session.name.split(" ").map(x=>x[0]).slice(0,2).join("").toUpperCase(),photo=storageGet(PHOTO_KEY+session.username);document.getElementById("profilePhoto").innerHTML=photo?`<img src="${photo}" alt="Profile photo">`:ini;document.getElementById("profileName").textContent=d.fullName;document.getElementById("profileRoleText").textContent=session.role;document.getElementById("pfFullName").value=d.fullName;if(document.getElementById("pfUsername"))document.getElementById("pfUsername").value=session.username;document.getElementById("pfNpp").value=d.npp;document.getElementById("pfRole").value=session.role;document.getElementById("pfUnit").value=d.unit;document.getElementById("pfRegion").value=d.region;document.getElementById("pfEmail").value=d.email;document.getElementById("pfPhone").value=d.phone;document.getElementById("profileScope").value=session.role==="TSCC User"?"Primary + collaborating cases":session.role==="Team Leader"?"Team cases":session.role==="Department Head"?"Management scope":session.role==="Admin"?"System configuration":"Own requester tickets"}function saveProfile(){let store=profileStore(),d={...profileDefaults(),...(store[session.username]||{})};d.fullName=document.getElementById("pfFullName").value.trim()||session.name;d.email=document.getElementById("pfEmail").value.trim();d.phone=document.getElementById("pfPhone").value.trim();store[session.username]=d;saveProfileStore(store);alert("Profile updated.");renderProfile()}function changeProfilePhoto(e){let file=e.target.files?.[0];if(!file)return;if(file.size>1024*1024){alert("Use an image smaller than 1 MB for this prototype.");return}let r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{storageSet(PHOTO_KEY+session.username,r.result);renderProfile()};r.readAsDataURL(file)}function removeProfilePhoto(){storageRemove(PHOTO_KEY+session.username);renderProfile()}function renderAccountSettings(){let lang=storageGet(LANGUAGE_KEY+(session?.username||"user"))||"en";document.querySelectorAll("input[name=uiLanguage]").forEach(x=>x.checked=x.value===lang);["currentPw","newPw","confirmPw"].forEach(id=>{let el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.value=""});document.getElementById("passwordMsg").innerHTML="";updatePasswordStrength()}function togglePassword(id,btn){let el=document.getElementById(id);el.type=el.type==="password"?"text":"password";btn.textContent=el.type==="password"?"Show":"Hide"}function passwordScore(v){let s=0;if(v.length>=8)s++;if(/[A-Z]/.test(v)&&/[a-z]/.test(v))s++;if(/\d/.test(v))s++;if(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v))s++;return s}function updatePasswordStrength(){let v=document.getElementById("newPw")?.value||"",s=passwordScore(v);document.querySelectorAll("#pwMeter span").forEach((x,i)=>x.classList.toggle("on",i<s));let r=document.getElementById("pwReq");if(r)r.textContent=s>=3?"Password meets the prototype requirements.":"Use at least 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, and a number."}function changePassword(){let cur=document.getElementById("currentPw").value,n=document.getElementById("newPw").value,c=document.getElementById("confirmPw").value,msg=document.getElementById("passwordMsg");if(!cur){msg.innerHTML='<div class="error-msg">Current password is required.</div>';return}if(passwordScore(n)<3){msg.innerHTML='<div class="error-msg">New password does not meet the requirements.</div>';return}if(n!==c){msg.innerHTML='<div class="error-msg">New password and confirmation do not match.</div>';return}msg.innerHTML='<div class="success-msg">Password update simulated successfully. No plaintext password was stored by this prototype.</div>';["currentPw","newPw","confirmPw"].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value="");updatePasswordStrength()}const I18N={en:{dashboard:"Dashboard",myCases:"My Cases",quickDraft:"Quick Draft",draftCases:"Draft Cases",reports:"Reports",profile:"Profile"},id:{dashboard:"Dashboard",myCases:"Case Saya",quickDraft:"Draft Cepat",draftCases:"Draft Case",reports:"Laporan",profile:"Profil"}};function saveLanguage(v){storageSet(LANGUAGE_KEY+(session?.username||'user'),v);applyLanguage()}function applyLanguage(){let l=storageGet(LANGUAGE_KEY+(session?.username||'user'))||'en',d=I18N[l]||I18N.en;let map={dashboard:d.dashboard,myCases:d.myCases,quickDraft:d.quickDraft,draftCases:d.draftCases,profile:d.profile};Object.entries(map).forEach(([id,label])=>{let el=document.querySelector(`[data-page="${id}"] span`);if(el)el.textContent=label})}
function toggleAccountMenu(){document.getElementById("accountMenu").classList.toggle("hidden");refreshIcons()}function hideAccountMenu(){document.getElementById("accountMenu").classList.add("hidden")}function signOut(){hideAccountMenu();session=null;document.getElementById("loginPass").value="";showLogin()}
/* SELECTS / EVENTS */
function fill(id,vals){let e=document.getElementById(id);if(!e)return;let first=e.options[0]?.outerHTML||"",curr=e.value;e.innerHTML=first+[...new Set(vals.filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b))).map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join("");if(vals.includes(curr))e.value=curr}
function populateFilters(){fill("myStatus",CONFIG.lifecycle);fill("myProduct",[...CONFIG.products,...cases.map(c=>c.product)]);fill("myOrigin",[...new Set(cases.map(originLabel))]);fill("mfCategory",CONFIG.categories);fill("mfSupport",[...CONFIG.supportUnits,...cases.map(c=>c.supportingUnit)]);fill("mfCollaborator",USERS.filter(u=>u.role==="TSCC User").map(u=>u.name));fill("teamPic",USERS.filter(u=>u.role==="TSCC User").map(u=>u.name));fill("teamStatus",CONFIG.lifecycle);fill("teamInvolvement",CONFIG.involvement);populateAIPageFilters()}
function refreshAll(){populateFilters();updateDraftCount();let p=document.querySelector(".page.active")?.id;if(p)goPage(p)}
function exportCSV(a,label="Cases"){let h=["Ticket","Requester","Primary PIC","Collaborators","Product","Normalized Category","Raw Category","Subject","Lifecycle","Urgency","Last Update"],rows=a.map(c=>[c.ticket,c.requesterName,canonicalPicName(c.primaryPic),(c.collaborators||[]).map(canonicalPicName).join("; "),c.product,displayCategory(c),c.rawCategory||c.category,displaySubject(c),c.lifecycle,urgency(c),c.lastUpdate]),csv=[h,...rows].map(r=>r.map(v=>`"${String(v??"").replaceAll('"','""')}"`).join(",")).join("\n"),el=document.createElement("a");el.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:"text/csv"}));el.download=`tcams_${label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_')}.csv`;el.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(el.href)}
function bindIfPresent(id,event,handler){let el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.addEventListener(event,handler)}
function initEvents(){
  document.querySelectorAll(".menu-item[data-page]").forEach(b=>{if(!b.onclick)b.addEventListener("click",()=>goPage(b.dataset.page))});
  ["mySearch","myStatus","myProduct","myUrgency","myOrigin","myLastUpdate","mfCategory","mfSupport","mfCollaborator","mfFrom","mfTo"].forEach(id=>bindIfPresent(id,id==="mySearch"?"input":"change",renderMyCases));
  ["teamSearch","teamPic","teamStatus","teamInvolvement"].forEach(id=>bindIfPresent(id,id==="teamSearch"?"input":"change",renderTeamMonitoring));
  ["insPeriod","insRegion","insProduct","insCategory","insInvolvement","insSupport"].forEach(id=>bindIfPresent(id,"change",renderManagementInsights));
  ["aiRegion","aiProduct","aiCategory"].forEach(id=>bindIfPresent(id,"change",renderAIInsightsPage));
  bindIfPresent("caseModal","click",e=>{if(e.target.id==="caseModal")closeModal()});
  document.addEventListener("click",e=>{let wrap=document.querySelector(".account-wrap");if(wrap&&!wrap.contains(e.target))hideAccountMenu()});
}
function bootTCAMS(){
  const steps=[["load",load],["initLogin",initLogin],["initEvents",initEvents],["populateFilters",populateFilters],["populateFormOptions",populateFormOptions],["refreshIcons",refreshIcons]];
  const errors=[];
  for(const [name,fn] of steps){try{fn()}catch(e){console.error("T-CAMS boot error in "+name,e);errors.push(name+": "+(e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)))}}
  if(errors.length){
    const box=document.getElementById("loginError");
    if(box){box.textContent="Some optional components could not initialize. Core navigation remains available.";box.classList.remove("hidden")}
  }
}
bootTCAMS();
</script>
</body>
</html>
